description: Contract A TSTOREs slot 0x01=0xAA, then DELEGATECALLs into Contract B which TSTOREs slot 0x01=0xBB and slot 0x02=0xCC before REVERTing. B's transient writes must be discarded; only A's original write should survive extraction.
